guidance: Ironclad A0 floor14 MAP, 60/80 HP, 87 gold, Weak Potion held. Only legal node is Monster row14/col2, then a Rest Site row15 before Soul Fysh. Use the current hand and intent every action. Strike Dummy makes Strikes stronger, especially Replay1; Omnislice is free group damage; Bash creates Vulnerable for Dismantle's double hit, and Rampage gains damage each use. Headbutt can recur a high-value discarded card. Gorget supplies Plating and Cloak Clasp rewards unplayed hand cards at turn end, so compare block and attacks against actual incoming rather than automatically emptying the hand. Use Weak Potion if it avoids substantial HP loss or a lethal risk, but retain it for boss if ordinary cards safely win. Claim all rewards; favor consistent boss damage/defense, skip filler. Stop at floor15 MAP, terminal or safety boundary.
